title: Dragon Ball Super’s New Anime Needs to Bring Back Super Saiyan 4
content: Dragon Ball Daima brought the moment many avid fans had waited for with the introduction of Super Saiyan 4 into canon. It took nearly 30 years to make it happen, as Dragon Ball GT is still not recognized in the official story, but Akira Toriyama made it happen.
author: ComicBook

title: Final Love Live! Nijigasaki High School Idol Club Anime Film's Teaser Unveils February 5 Opening
content: The official website for Love Live! Nijigasaki Gakuen School Idol Dōkōkai Kanketsu-hen finale trilogy began streaming a teaser video for Love Live! Nijigasaki Gakuen School Idol Dōkōkai Kanketsu-hen Saishūshō , the third and final film in the trilogy, on Saturday.
author: ANN

title: Manga 'Shiawase Kanako no Koroshiya Seikatsu' Gets TV Anime in Spring 2027
content: Production company TOHO animation opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Toshiya Wakabayashi 's Shiawase Kanako no Koroshiya Seikatsu ( Happy Kanako's Killer Life ) manga on Saturday, revealing the main cast, staff, a teaser visual (pictured), and teaser promotional video.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Happy Kanako’s Killer Life TV Anime Adaptation Officially Announced for April 2027
content: Toshiya Wakabayashi’s Happy Kanako’s Killer Life is officially getting a TV anime adaptation in April 2027, as announced by TOHO animation. The announcement follows a teaser from TOHO animation, which confirmed that it would reveal a new TV anime on October 17 at midnight JST.
author: Anime Corner

title: Happy Kanako's Killer Life Manga Gets TV Anime Next April
content: TOHO animation announced on Saturday that Toshiya Wakabayashi 's Happy Kanako's Killer Life ( Shiawase Kanako no Koroshiya Seikatsu ) manga is receiving a television anime adaptation next April. Shinji Takamatsu ( Gintama ) is directing the anime at the studio Drive and overseeing the series scripts.
author: ANN

title: Love Live! Nijigasaki High School Idol Club Final Chapter Movie Reveals Trailer, February 5 2027 Premiere
content: The last part of the trilogy, Love Live! Nijigasaki High School Idol Club Final Chapter movie released a trailer on Friday. The movie is set to release on February 5, 2027 in Japan. The first part of the trilogy premiered in Japan on September 6, 2024, while the second part was released on November 7, 2025.
author: Anime Corner

title: Record of Lodoss War: The Crown of the Covenant Novel Series Resumes
content: Kadokawa published the first novel volume in Japan in September 2019 with illustrations by Hidari . The novel was the first new novel for the Record of Lodoss War franchise in 12 years. Atsushi Suzumi launched a manga adaptation of the new novel in October 2019.
author: ANN

title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Reveals The Last Trailer Ahead of Final 2 New Episodes
content: BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War has released a new ‘the last’ trailer ahead of the anime’s final two episodes, set to conclude Tite Kubo’s final manga arc. The anime returned with the fourth and final cour, subtitled The Calamity , on July 25, before delaying the final two episodes to improve quality .
author: Anime Corner

title: BanG Dream! Ave Mujica prima aurora Anime Film Reveals 2nd Promo Video
content: The official YouTube channel for the BanG Dream! franchise began streaming a second promotional video on Friday for the BanG Dream! Ave Mujica prima aurora anime film project. The video previews Ave Mujica's song "A Song of Romance." The film opened in Japan on Friday. The BanG Dream! It's MyGo!!!!!
author: ANN

title: Golden Kamuy's Live-Action Adaptation Continues With 'Karafuto Pursuit Arc' Series in January
content: WOWOW announced on Friday it will stream a new live-action series based on Satoru Noda 's Golden Kamuy manga starting on January 24 at 10:00 p.m. The series is titled Golden Kamuy : Karafuto Tsuiseki-hen (Golden Kamuy: Karafuto Pursuit Arc).
author: ANN
